title: Body Scan
description: Move attention slowly through the body, from the feet to the crown.

steps.text: Lie down if you can, or sit comfortably. Let your eyes close.
Take a few slow breaths. Feel the weight of your body against the floor or the chair.
Bring your attention to your feet. The soles, the toes, the heels. Simply notice whatever is there. Warmth, coolness, pressure, or nothing at all.
Move up to the ankles, the calves, the knees.
Now the legs, the hips, the pelvis. Let them be heavy.
Notice the belly. It rises and falls on its own. You don't need to help it.
The lower back. The upper back. Let anything that is holding, soften.
The chest, and the heartbeat, if you can feel it.
Shoulders. Arms. Hands. Let the fingers rest.
The neck and the throat. The jaw. The small muscles around the eyes.
The forehead, the scalp, the crown of the head.
Now feel the whole body at once. Breathing. Here.
Begin to move a little. The fingers, the toes. When you're ready, open your eyes.
